title: Shueisha Launches Manga Million Platform in Hindi, English
content: Japanese publishing company Shueisha announced on Thursday that it has launched its global digital manga platform " MANGA MILLION " in Hindi and English, among other languages. The application has over one million pages of translated manga from 400 titles at launch.
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Opens in Indonesia on August 28
content: Indonesian film distributor CBI Pictures announced on Tuesday that it will release Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, in Indonesia on August 28.
author: ANN

title: Sega Appoints Black White Orange as Indian Licensing Agent for Angry Birds
content: Angry Birds Movie 3 will release in Indian theaters in January 2027 with English and Hindi dubs. Sega 's Sonic Racing CrossWorlds racing game will add the character Red from Angry Birds with the Super Roaster vehicle in April.

title: 'Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi' Unveils Additional Cast Pair, Theme Song, Third Trailer
content: The official website for the Made in Abyss anime series revealed a pair of additional cast members, the theme song, and a third trailer for the Mezameru Shinpi ( Awakening Mystery ) anime movie on Friday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on October 23.
author: MyAnimeList

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With Anime Teaser Visual Revealed
content: The upcoming TV anime My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With has revealed its first teaser visual following the adaptation’s announcement earlier this year. The visual features the legendary Sword Saint Liza blushing with a sword, and you can check it out below.

title: My Hero Academia’s New Anime Delivers the True Finale Fans Deserved
content: My Hero Academia is one of the most successful Shonen anime and manga series of all time. Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, the manga reached its conclusion on August 5th, 2024, after a decade of serialization.

title: Shingo Natsume, Madhouse's ghost – end of night Original Anime Film Unveils Teaser, Cast
content: The official website for ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), Shingo Natsume and Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, unveiled a new teaser trailer for the anime film on Friday. The teaser reveals the film's two lead cast members.
